title: kpdf: noticeably laggier on Wayland than X11 -- undiagnosed

description:
Maintainer dogfooding report, 2026-08-28: some checkboxes in kpdf do not respond. 'Some' is the key word — others do work, so this is not the wiring.

Wiring is present and looks correct: kpdf's form click handler routes FieldKind::Checkbox|Radio to form::toggle_checkbox, which sets /V on the group head and /AS on the kids via set_check_grp, then writes an incremental update. read_on_state is a faithful port of MuPDF's find_on_state (first non-Off key of /AP /N, falling back to /AP /D).

So the likely culprits, in order:
1. The widget has no non-Off on-state in /AP /N — toggle then guesses 'Yes', which will not match the appearance dict, so /AS names a state with no stream and nothing visibly changes.
2. The field is classified something other than Checkbox/Radio (kpdf refuses Combobox/Listbox outright).
3. The field is read-only and kpdf says so in the status bar — worth confirming the maintainer is not hitting this case.
4. The hit test misses the widget (rect vs widened hit area).

NEXT STEP, no repro file needed: run kpdf-doctor (added 3b94137) on the offending PDF. Its FIELD lines print kind, read_only, on_state and a togglable verdict naming which of the above applies. Paste that output here and this becomes a one-line diagnosis instead of a guess.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
RESOLVED 2026-08-28 (commit 5e64234) — not a form.rs bug.

kpdf-doctor on the maintainer's workbook: 205 Checkbox + 489 Radio fields, 294 togglable, ZERO refused. Toggle logic, on-state detection and the /V+/AS write were all already correct.

Real cause: forms_mode defaulted to false, so field clicks were disabled entirely, with nothing on screen hinting a toolbar toggle stood in the way. Indistinguishable from broken checkboxes.

Fix: a document with an /AcroForm now opens with Forms mode on (first open and 'o' swap alike), enforcing toggle_forms_mode's Pan-tool invariant, with a status line saying so.

The remaining visual complaint on that document — form text drawn as boxes — is a separate root cause: bd-veq / gh-94 (non-embedded fonts).

title: kpdf: some checkboxes do not tick
